_meta.title: Automation tool pricing history
_meta.thesis: Across the major automation platforms, core pricing has barely moved in two years. Here is the evidence — every claim links to a dated Web Archive snapshot.
_meta.method: Curated from Web Archive (Wayback Machine) snapshots of each vendor's pricing page, 2024-06 to 2026-06. Only CONFIRMED, evidence-linked events are published; rendering and packaging artifacts are labelled as such, not as price changes. Live figures cross-checked against our daily price audit (verified 2026-06-12).
_meta.note: Zdroj pravdy = tato data, kurátorovaná z calc-test/wayback/ verdiktů (2026-06-12). Stránka generována build.py → render_price_history. CONFIRMED-only; gapy a artefakty přiznané.

tools.name: Zapier
tools.headline: No core price change in 2+ years

events.title: AI Agents add-on launched (not a core price change)
events.detail: An "Agents (Beta) — Starts at $50/mo" block appeared on the pricing page alongside the existing Chatbots / Interfaces / Tables teasers. Core automation plans were unchanged.

events.title: Packaging overhaul — "Pro" renamed "Professional" (core prices unchanged)
events.detail: Zaps, Tables and Interfaces were merged into unified platform plans; Agents and Chatbots got their own tabs and tiers. Core prices stayed $0 / $19.99 / $69. This is the layout you see today.

tools.name: Make
tools.headline: Annual prices flat since at least Feb 2025

events.title: Archive showed monthly prices ($12 / $21 / $38) — a display default, not a price hike
events.detail: From mid-May 2026 the archived page rendered the monthly variant of the same plans. The live annual list price stayed $9 / $16 / $29 (verified 2026-06-12). No actual price change.

gaps.reason: The pricing page rendered prices client-side, so archived HTML for this window is empty — no reliable figures.

tools.name: n8n
tools.headline: One real overhaul (Aug 2025): workflow limits removed + Business tier

events.title: Major overhaul — workflow limits removed, Business tier added
events.detail: Until 6 Aug 2025: Starter $24/$20 (monthly/annual) capped at 5 active workflows; Pro $60/$50 capped at 15; plus a $120/mo tier (50k exec / 50 workflows). On 7 Aug 2025 the workflow/step/user limits were removed (now unlimited), quotas were rewritten to annual, the $120 tier was discontinued and a Business plan ($667 / $800 annual / monthly) appeared.

events.title: Monthly variants dropped from the page (display change, not prices)
events.detail: The page stopped rendering the monthly figures (24 / 60 / 800) in HTML and defaulted to annual only. The annual prices themselves did not change.

gaps.reason: Pricing rendered client-side in this window — archived HTML has no figures.

tools.open_question: Currency: the Aug 2025 archive showed USD ($24 / $20); the live page today is in EUR (€24 / €20). When (or whether) the $→€ switch happened can't be pinned from the archive.

tools.name: Pipedream
tools.headline: Core flat; free tier cut and a new Connect plan

events.title: Connect plan ($99/mo) launched (new plan, not a price change)
events.detail: A new "Connect" plan ($99/mo, 10k credits, auth for external users) was added to the lineup. A catalogue addition rather than a change to existing prices.

events.title: Free tier cut: 300 → 100 credits / mo
events.detail: The free monthly credit allowance dropped from 300 (April 2025) to 100 (January 2026) — a real reduction in the free tier. The exact date falls inside this window; the live tier today is 100 credits / mo.

gaps.reason: The page moved to client-side rendering — archived HTML has no figures for this window; live data comes from our own audit.
